title: ArrangementCreated.v1
description: Payload of the ArrangementCreated event (A§23). Emitted by arrangement-service — the single producer (A§7.2) — when a payment plan is created via `POST /v1/arrangements` (A§17, A§10.3 DRAFT -> ACTIVE). The instalment schedule is embedded deliberately, not linked: payment-service allocates incoming money to specific instalments oldest-first and must be able to build its `active_arrangements` read model from the event stream alone, without calling back into arrangement-service (A§7.3, SVC-6). Published on `collections.arrangement` keyed by `arrangementId` (A§23). Schedule invariants, enforced at creation and rejected with 400 ARRANGEMENT_INVALID otherwise (invariant A§11.5, SVC-5): at least one instalment; the sum of `schedule[].amountMinor` equals `totalAmountMinor` exactly in integer minor units (rounding remainder assigned to the last instalment); `dueDate` values strictly ascending; `installmentId` values unique. Rides the A§24 envelope; a breaking change ships as ArrangementCreated.v2 (D§29).

arrangementId.description: Platform identifier of the arrangement. Equal to the envelope `aggregateId` and the Kafka partition key (A§23).

accountId.description: Platform identifier of the account the plan repays. Payment allocation is account-scoped, so this is the field payment-service keys its read model on.

caseId.description: Platform identifier (bare ULID) of the case the arrangement was agreed on, or null for an arrangement created outside a case (e.g. a self-service plan taken in the customer portal before a case exists). Structurally always present, so required and nullable. Nullable ULID: expressed as the envelope's ULID definition unioned with null, so the pattern lives in exactly one place (contracts/README §6) and is never re-declared here.

promiseId.description: Platform identifier (bare ULID) of the promise this plan formalises, or null when the arrangement was agreed without a preceding promise. Keeps the promise-to-arrangement conversion rate measurable from the event stream (A§47). Nullable ULID: expressed as the envelope's ULID definition unioned with null, so the pattern lives in exactly one place (contracts/README §6) and is never re-declared here.

totalAmountMinor.description: Total amount the plan repays, in minor units of `currency`. Exactly equal to the sum of `schedule[].amountMinor` — it is published explicitly so a consumer can validate the schedule it received rather than trusting it (integer arithmetic only, no floats anywhere in the chain). Strictly positive.

currency.description: ISO-4217 alpha-3 currency of `totalAmountMinor` and of every instalment amount in `schedule`. One arrangement has exactly one currency, which is why the instalment objects carry no currency of their own.

schedule.description: The full instalment schedule, ordered by `dueDate` ascending. Embedded rather than referenced so payment allocation needs no synchronous call (SVC-6). Instalment amounts are in the arrangement `currency`.

installment.title: Installment
installment.description: One scheduled instalment of the plan. `installmentId` is the allocation target payment-service names in PaymentAllocated, which is how a payment is attributed to a specific instalment rather than to the plan as a whole.

installmentId.description: Platform identifier of this instalment, unique within the arrangement and stable for its whole life. Quoted back by PaymentAllocated so arrangement-service can mark exactly this instalment PAID (SVC-5/SVC-6).

dueDate.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) this instalment is due. Strictly greater than the previous instalment's due date; the first is on or after the arrangement creation date.

amountMinor.description: Amount due for this instalment, in minor units of the arrangement `currency`. Strictly positive; the rounding remainder of an uneven split is assigned to the last instalment by an explicit documented rule, never spread by floating point (SVC-5).
